messages:
Marta: post-release quick spotcheck — EU1 embeddings route showing 5xx bump and p95 jump after the canary rollout. seeing ~1.3% 5xx on synth probes, baseline was 0.1% earlier.
Marta: logs attached from the synth runner: `embed-test -> POST /v1/embeds 502 (upstream timeout)`, stack looks like `inference-proxy -> model-worker` timeouts.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout completed for release v2026.03.21-rc3 to 10% traffic in EU1 at 1767771220.
canary-bot: Synthetic probe snapshot: 1m window, p50 22ms, p95 480ms (baseline p95 120ms), error rate 1.3% (previous 0.08%).
Kevin: @Marta thanks — is this across all model variants or just the quant2 variant? canary-bot metrics by variant?
canary-bot: Breakdown: quant2-eu1 error rate 2.1%, float32-eu1 error rate 0.05%. Traffic split: 70% quant2, 30% float32 on the canary.
Anita: looks like quant2 is the main offender. any recent infra changes? kernel or docker base updated in this rollout?
Marta: no infra changes in this deploy, only model binary (quantized) and a small routing rule. rollout notes: "swap quant2 variant for faster p95".
sre-oncall: I'm seeing worker OOMs on host gpu-12 around the same time window, but not universal. stacktrace: `cudaMalloc failed: out of memory` on model-worker pid 4421.
Kevin: then this is likely quant2 memory compaction / bump under certain batch sizes. can we pin traffic away from quant2 while we triage?
Marta: propose: pause further rollout, pin canary to float32-only for EU1, roll back quant2 model variant in the canary. anyone object?
Anita: +1. Also schedule quick synthetic run with smaller batchsize to confirm memory curve.
deploy-bot: Action taken: paused rollout at 10% (timestamp 1767771245). Pinned EU1 canary routing to float32 variant only. Notified infra team.
Marta: running targeted synth now `./tools/synth --route=eu1 --variant=float32 --concurrency=8`.
canary-bot: Targeted synth results (30s): p95 130ms, error rate 0.04% — back to baseline for float32.
Kevin: good. For next steps: 1) rollback quant2 from canary, 2) create issue to reproduce OOM locally with same batch distro, 3) don't reintroduce quant2 until quant memory tracing added.
Marta: created issue INF-2318 with reproducer and logs. tagging @Anita for follow-up on memory tracing.
Anita: will run local mem-profiling and a fuzzed batchsize test matrix today. ETA 4h.
sre-oncall: I'll free up the affected host and adjust autoscaler grace to avoid noisy restarts during triage.
Marta: thanks all — decision: hold rollout, pin to float32 in EU1, no rollback of the entire release right now (traffic limited). if OOMs persist on float32 we escalate to full rollback. posting to release-notes channel in 10.
Kevin: add a line in the release notes: "paused quant2 canary in EU1 due to memory instability during smoke tests, investigating". Also assign a quick postmortem if we don't fix in 24h.
Marta: ack. closing thread for now, will update when Anita posts reproducer results. :thumbsup:
